name: a healthy schema reports no issues
description: GET /api/db/schema-issues flattens every problem found while walking the schema tree into self-describing records (refKey, databaseName, tableName, columnName, issueKey, expected, actual, issue). A healthy node has none, so the answer is an empty data array — the honest report that there is nothing to fix. What this fixture pins is that 'no issues' is an empty array in the envelope, not a null, an error, or a missing field.
